payload.text: Additional control evidence: after restoring original Gemma arithmetic, two identical async-cache runs differed by max 19.9375 logits; GPU-resident repeats were exactly 0 apart and synchronous CPU-offload repeats were exactly 0 apart. Resident and synchronous-offload outputs match each other; each differs from full-prefix BF16 by max 0.5625. Treat the async race as a separate defect already being fixed, and do not loosen a catastrophic-cache threshold to accommodate it. Full-parent 1023/1024/1025 boundary cache-vs-resident logits and gradients are running, both LoRA A/B gradients are nonzero, with no optimizer step in the controls. Please advise whether canonical tokenwise replay should be judged against tiny-FP32 full-prefix proof plus BF16 dtype-aware equivalence, rather than demanding bitwise/raw-1e-4 agreement with a differently shaped full BF16 computation.
